name: Dismantlable Ample Classes Satisfy the Factorwise Product Theorem
statement: For finite partial cubes $G_1,G_2$, the product $G_1\square G_2$ is dismantlable ample if and only if both factors are dismantlable ample.
proof: Given prefix-isometric orders of the factors, order product vertices by nondecreasing sum of their two order indices. Factor geodesics stay in every prefix, proving sufficiency. Each factor is a convex coordinate face of the product, so pc-minor closure proves necessity.
